title: A curve and its abstract generalized Jacobian
summary: To a smooth proper curve $C$ over a field $k$ equipped with a $k$-point $c$ and an effective divisor $\mathfrak m$ coprime to $c$, one may associate the abstract group $J_{\mathfrak m}(\bar k)$ of $\overline k$-points of the generalized Jacobian, as well as a subset \[ \tag{*} \big(C\setminus \operatorname{Supp}(\mathfrak m)\big)(\bar k) \subset J_{\mathfrak m}(\bar k). \] We show that the data $(C,c,\mathfrak m)$ can be retrieved from (*) up to a twist by an automorphism of $\overline k$, proving a conjecture of Booher and Voloch.
